title: Restlessness to Self-Worth
subtitle: A cross-linked bridge between two recurring pressures
description: Guru answers wandering with saint company, listening, and honest stillness. This bridge then carries into guru restores worth by placing identity inside grace, humility, and belonging to the one.

heroSource.shortMeaning: Searching and ritual are not identical with peace.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Do not confuse spiritual activity with inward arrival.
